kind: Observed outcomes, not accepted resolution rules or automated Norn expectations.
limitations: Manual opening reports cover iPhone/iOS only, not case-sensitive filesystem behavior.
Device-side filename normalization and Obsidian normalization cannot be distinguished by these observations.
M10, M11 and W23 were specifically opened after their source links were rewritten by the spaced-name rename.
W14, M26, W24, W18 and W25 opened documents absent from the original fixture; their outcomes are not proof that the original missing inputs resolved.
M22 reports a UI error. It has no confirmed destination and establishes no missing-target resolution rule.
The rename before-values come from the checked-in fixture, not an immediately preceding source capture.
The remaining 49 cases have no captured rename source text. All six link-creation setting combinations remain unobserved.
Click-to-create behavior is outside the required Norn behavior.
